senses.gloss: to be molten, to be in a state of dissolution or liquefaction.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 53b">Ib. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ הבשר</he> if (in one spot of an animal known to have been attacked by a beast of prey) the flesh appears decayed; <cite ref="Chullin 53b:14">ib.</cite> <he>היכי דמי נ׳</he> what do you mean by ‘decayed’ (Answ.) <he>כל שחרופא וכ׳</he> what a physician would peel off, until he comes on sound flesh; <cite ref="Chullin 77a:7">ib. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְמַסְמֵס</he>. Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ top <he>שנִיתְמַסְמְסוּ בני מעיה</he> (a melon) the core of which is liquefied.
